r4a-new-method.title: New-method adjudication (Admiral-delegated)
r4a-new-method.imperative: Adjudicate whether the rotating-block deterministic-averaged split scheme crosses into NEW STATISTICAL METHOD (forbidden) or is a legitimate read-adapter generalization of the landed exhaustive-2v2-averaged scheme. State a reasoned verdict; BLOCK+FLOAT to Admiral if it crosses.
r4a-new-method.finding: VERDICT: legitimate read-adapter generalization, does NOT cross into new statistical method. Reasoning: (1) The estimator/decision machinery -- compare_channels_by_class, grand_two_way_center (double-centering), r_floor, channel_tie_margin (via frozen_replication_thresholds), main_effect_margin_uncertainty, widen_sigma_for_margin_uncertainty, out_of_sample_coverage, and critically decide_channel_from_mean_r (the F12-registered average-then-decide rule) -- are IMPORTED and byte-unchanged, independently confirmed: zero diff on src/physics/instrument_panel/* and scripts/instrument_panel_668_report.py; grep + the implementer's own test (test_no_local_reimplementation_of_frozen_rule_names) show none of these names is locally re-defined or reassigned in the new script; they only appear as import statements or call-sites. (2) The ONLY new logic is enumerate_rotating_half_partitions, which replaces enumerate_2v2_partitions (hard-coded to exactly 4 circuits, producing the 3 EXHAUSTIVE 2v2 partitions). This is a partition-ENUMERATION/sampling-design function, not a statistic: it feeds the SAME downstream averaging-then-decide pipeline (_combine_class_verdict -> decide_channel_from_mean_r) that #668 already used over its 3 exhaustive partitions -- only the source and count of partitions changed (K=10 fixed deterministic rotating-block partitions in place of K=3 exhaustive ones), not what is computed FROM those partitions or how the final call is made. (3) The construction itself (sort to canonical order, slide a contiguous half-window, K=n/2 distinct partitions) is a standard systematic/circular sampling design (akin to round-robin/circular block designs), not an invented statistic -- it contains no probability model, no new tunable threshold, no new formula for r or sigma. (4) It satisfies every element of the Admiral's pre-ruled SHAPE verbatim: deterministic (independently confirmed: two independent calls with different input orderings produce byte-identical partitions), seed-free (grep + the implementer's own structural test confirm no random/np.random/seed anywhere), balanced (independently confirmed: every partition splits into two equal n/2 halves covering the full circuit set with empty intersection), averaged over K>1 fixed partitions (K=10, confirmed), and the exact construction is stated in the report (SPLIT_SCHEME_NOTE, independently read). The Admiral's ruling explicitly delegated ONLY the exact construction choice to the implementer while freezing everything else -- rotating-block is a reasonable, disclosed instantiation of that delegated choice, not an unauthorized expansion of latitude. (5) One nuance NOT rising to a blocker (flagged separately as triage candidate tc2): unlike the #668 case where K=3 was EXHAUSTIVE (zero correlation-among-samples question), the rotating-block's stride-1 sliding window makes adjacent k-partitions differ by only one circuit, so the K=10 samples are structurally correlated rather than independent or exhaustive -- this is a legitimate open question about how well this specific systematic design's variance-reduction property matches the exhaustive case, worth a follow-up sensitivity check, but it is a DESIGN-QUALITY question about the partitioning choice, not evidence that a new statistic/decision-rule was introduced. CONCLUSION: no BLOCK, no float to Admiral required on the new-method question -- the central adjudication clears.

triage_candidates.statement: Season-scale replication verdict is mostly unresolved/unmeasurable (only severity:c1 fully unmeasurable, others unresolved -- no channel clears r_floor after double-centering at 20-circuit scale). Honest small-signal result per no-frame-kill doctrine, not a defect -- but routes a real question to G5 season report/Admiral: is this a genuine season-scale null, or does double-centering remove too much signal at this N? Independently confirmed via real run (severity:c0 mean_r util=0.278 vs r_floor=0.500, etc).

Methodological nuance (not a blocker, not new-method): the rotating-block (stride-1 sliding window) construction makes ADJACENT k-partitions differ by only ONE circuit swapping halves, so the K=10 samples are structurally correlated (not independent draws from the partition space), unlike the #668 4-circuit case where K=3 was EXHAUSTIVE (every distinct partition, no correlation-among-samples question). This may understate/overstate the variance-reduction benefit relative to a less-correlated systematic design (e.g. a coprime stride). Worth a follow-up sensitivity check (e.g. compare against a non-adjacent stride) before the season-scale replication verdict is treated as tightly calibrated -- routed to G5/Admiral, not a defect in this bounded read-adapter.

Tooling debt (implementer-surfaced, seconded): #668 script's build_half_cells/half_cell_sem/_resolved_grid are private module-level helpers, not exported API, so this read-adapter had to DUPLICATE ~35 lines of pure aggregation arithmetic (confirmed byte-identical to the #668 originals) rather than import them. Candidate: export these as public API (or move to src/physics/instrument_panel/replication.py as pure injectable utilities) so a future corpus-scale adapter imports rather than duplicates.
